changelog: Four things found by using the previous build. An image subtitle track (Blu-ray PGS, DVD VobSub) can no longer be picked or queued - it always failed, and the failure was counted against the run; the track is still listed, now unselectable, with the reason on it. The run box says each number once (the workers line says what the workers are doing, the counts line how the run is going), no longer estimates a time it cannot estimate, and no longer keeps a per-file record of what happened - that is what History is for. The run box also shows only on the Sync tab.
description: Synchronize subtitles with video audio using ffsubsync
name: SubSync
overview: Adds a Sync Subtitles action to any video, using ffsubsync as backend
